text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Champions Cup, things
between
Copano Rickey and Hokko
Tarumae have been a
little awkward.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
About what happened the other day—I
think I
might have gone too far with
what I said to
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She only spoke so firmly because she
knows
Copano Rickey's true strength.
And besides, it
sounds like she regrets
taking that tone.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: So... how has Rickey been at training?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Super energetic? That must mean...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It must really be bothering her, then.
The worse
she feels, the less she shows
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's assessment is correct.
Copano
Rickey is actually...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Let's go, let's go, let's gooo! ♪ This time I'm definitely going to change Tarumae's whole impression of me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Super speedy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bigger the hole in her heart, the
more she
subconsciously tries to hide it
with forced
enthusiasm. But the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer! How was my time?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may be able to fake her attitude,
but she
can't fake a good performance.
choice_data_list: ...This isn't good. Your form is totally out of sync, too.
...This isn't good. Your form is totally out of sync, too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't worry? About what? I'm
completely
fine...
choice_data_list: Rickey, just try not to worry too much about it.
Rickey, just make sure not to worry too much about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My words won't get through to her
unless she
realizes what's troubling her.
At this rate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll probably struggle to run well in
the
February Stakes, much less secure
future wins.
She's stuck in a vicious cycle
that she can't see.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I want to make everyone happy...
But am I
getting offtrack?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Is making everyone happy... an
impossible goal?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't think like that! The power of
feng shui
is unstoppable! Nothing can
beat it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It hurts to watch her try and act like
she's all right.
I need to help her get
back to normal somehow...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Rickey really looks like she's having a
rough time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon comes over.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How did things get like this? All she
wants is for
everyone to be happy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know... I think all of us dirt racers
are a little
awkward somehow.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Some of us are too open about how we
feel, and
others struggle to say what
they're thinking.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But I love that about us. ☆ We're all
adorable in
our own way. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I agree. It's this combination of
personality
traits that can sometimes
cause
misunderstandings.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't really know. But I think
everyone
does their best when they can
stay on course and
stick to whatever
their goals are.
choice_data_list: What do you think we should do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Rickey wants to make everyone happy
with feng
shui! Tarumae wants to make
her hometown
famous! And I...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want my Umadol songs and dances to
pump
people up! ♪ We just need to
believe in ourselves
and keep working
hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until recently, Copano Rickey always
did exactly
that, but now she's
struggling to keep it up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we have any hope of getting through
this...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A favor? What is it?
choice_data_list: Smart Falcon, I have a favor to ask.
Smart Falcon, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pump Rickey up?
choice_data_list: Could you maybe cheer Rickey up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each and every racer shines in their own
unique
way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when there's nothing a trainer can
do, there
might be something another
racer can...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. And I'm the one who
said
everyone needs to stick to their
goals. So... ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll do what I can! ♪ I do have a little
more
experience than her, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay, just you wait and see! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What are we doing here, Trainer? What
about
today's training?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The stage?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait. Falco?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Rickey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Today's your lucky day! You're getting
your very
own Special Falco Concert!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You seem a little lost lately, so I'm here
to share
some motivation with you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Watch this show and get back some of
that feng
shui power you love so
much. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hit it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This song...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Do the things you love to do!
Try out
things you never knew! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All it takes is a little feng shui
To
brighten up everybody's days! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Keep runnin' and she'll get you Your feelings will get through, woohoo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard this song before, but it
sounds
like she wrote it for Copano
Rickey. Before I
know it, the music really
picks up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go, Rickey! ♪ Go, Rickey! ♪ Go, go,
Rickey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go, Rickey! ♪ Go, Rickey! ♪ Go, go,
Rickey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go, Rickey! ♪ Go, Rickey! ♪ Go, go,
Rickey! ♪
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wowww! Falco... Did you write a whole
song... just
for me?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Watching this performance... My heart
feels so...
Why do I feel this way?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With each beat of the music and every
smile on
Smart Falcon's face, Copano
Rickey's heart is
lifted higher and higher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of Umadols—the power
of Smart
Falcon's exceptional
performance.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yayyy! ☆ Did you enjoy it, Rickey? Do
you feel a
bit better?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I feel a lot better!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Great! I want to spread happiness
with my
Umadol performances!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But, but! There are definitely other ways
to make
people happy too. Not
everyone likes music,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And for those people, there's the power
of feng
shui! ☆ I'm sure there are people
out there
waiting for the kind of
encouragement only you
can offer.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Encouragement only I can offer...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ♪ Even if you get a little bit lost,
make sure
you keep on believing!
Believe in yourself!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine, Rickey! And you're on the
right
track. I mean, it doesn't matter how
you go about
it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You truly want everyone to be happy!
And that's
really wonderful. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I knew Smart Falcon would come
through. She's
got the strength of a true
idol—no, of an Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The weakened glimmer in Copano
Rickey's eyes
burns bright again. It's as if
the sealed qi within
has come pouring
out.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Feng shui isn't wrong... Of course
it's
not—it's what made me the happy
person I am!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Learning about feng shui as a child made
me so
happy. And it brought happiness
to the many
people I introduced it to as
well!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As long as I don't give up, I'm sure I can
keep the
circle of happiness going on
and on forever!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! ♪ Well, it looks to me like
you're good
to go. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks, Falco! Oh, and...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It was you, wasn't it, Trainer? You asked
Falco for
her help, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm more than a bit better! ♪ I'm so
energized I
feel like I could fly!
choice_data_list: Yeah. If that cheered you up even a little, I'm glad.
Yeah. If that cheered you up even a little, I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's like the fog has lifted from my mind.
Now I
know my only option is to be
myself and go all in
on what's most
important to me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! It's time to get serious again!
Rickey! ☆
Lucky! ☆ We're so back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with her incomparable support,
the
Umadol Smart Falcon revitalizes
Copano Rickey.
